_comment: Your project's retrieval eval set. Same shape as tests/ground_truth.json. Each entry maps a natural-language prompt someone on this project would actually type to the ranked rule ID(s) that SHOULD appear in the top-k. Run it with: clawness eval --data .clawness/eval/cases.json --floor-mrr <m> --floor-hit <h>. Measures MRR@k + hit-rate over RANKED rules only (mandatory rules are always injected, so they are not scored here). Replace the examples below with your own cases; keep the list stable as you edit rules so regressions are visible. NOTE: files under .clawness/ are gitignored by Clawness's default allowlist — add '!.clawness/eval/' to .gitignore if you want this committed and shared.

queries.q: example: replace with a prompt your team would type, e.g. 'how should I structure error handling in our service layer'
example: a prompt that should surface a house-style convention you moved out of the base prompt into .clawness/rules/
